issue_context.title: Add support for Apache Zeppelin
issue_context.body:
### Description

Add support for [Apache Zeppelin](https://zeppelin.apache.org/) in airflow.providers.apache package.

### Use case/motivation

- [Apache Zeppelin](https://zeppelin.apache.org/) is a 
web-based notebook that enables data-driven,
interactive data analytics and collaborative documents with SQL, Scala, Python, R and more.
- Our team are using customized zeppelin operator, enabling data engineers to use airflow to schedule zeppelin notes directly after they finish developing big data jobs like spark, hive, flink, etc. in zeppelin notes. This feature will greatly boost big-data development efficiency.
- We'd like to contribute this zeppelin-provider package to community.

### Related issues

_No response_
